description: This is a unit test file for the WPEFramework project testing the NodeId class, including various property accessors.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: A class representing network node identity, providing methods for hostname, port, address, and interface properties.

methods.name: NodeId::HostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname part of the node ID.

methods.name: NodeId::Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the node ID.

methods.name: NodeId::PortNumber
methods.description: Returns the port number of the node ID.

methods.name: NodeId::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the node ID is valid.

methods.name: NodeId::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the node ID.

methods.name: NodeId::QualifiedName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of the node.

methods.name: NodeId::IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Determines if the node is on a local interface.

methods.name: NodeId::IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Checks if the node refers to any interface.

methods.name: NodeId::IsMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the node address is multicast.
